selection.epochs_temperature_rule: Median of six internal fits, then fixed three-seed refit
selection.primary_policy: Always evaluate the frozen Transformer-only challenger; guard failure is not promotion
selection.secondary_policy: Optional incumbent blend requires positive gain and quality guards in both folds
selection.validation_policy: Both named outputs frozen jointly; no selection or tuning from their validation scores

mean_accuracy_interval.interpretation: Conditional on frozen models and development data, not selection-adjusted; crossing zero is not proof of equivalence
Conditional on frozen models and development data, not selection-adjusted; crossing zero is not proof of equivalence

evaluation.validation_role: Previously inspected development validation, not an untouched final test
evaluation.decision_policy: Primary and optional secondary were frozen jointly; validation does not select a winner

primary_transformer.interpretation: Conditional on fixed models and development data; not selection-adjusted

secondary_blend.interpretation: Conditional on fixed models and development data; not selection-adjusted

quality_notes.primary_transformer: NLL improved at all horizons; Brier improved at all horizons; ECE improved at all horizons.
quality_notes.secondary_blend: NLL improved at all horizons; Brier improved at all horizons; ECE changed across horizons.

parallel_execution.alongside: Main screen; independent already registered runs

parallel_execution.freeze: Standard confirm invoked only after both disjoint workers complete; same registered fits and selection.

parallel_execution.budgets: Exact jointly frozen component epochs and temperatures; no validation callbacks.

execution_notes.timing_interpretation: Some registered fits share the same RTX4090 concurrently. Summed fit timers include contention and exclude loading/setup/selection prediction; they are not elapsed wall time or isolated throughput.
